        About this item

        • THREE IDEAL SIZES FOR EVERY TASK - This bamboo cutting board set includes three essential cutting board sizes - 15x10”, 12x8”, 9x6” - covering all your kitchen needs. Use the small board for quick fruit prep, the medium for slicing vegetables, and the large for carving meats, rolling dough, or creating an elegant charcuterie board spread.
        • DESIGNED FOR FUNCTIONAL ELEGANCE – Crafted from 100% natural bamboo, these non toxic wooden cutting boards for kitchen combine modern design with practical performance. Perfectly complementing your kitchen appliances and favorite kitchen gadgets, their smooth, non-porous finish highlights the natural wood grain, blending durability with a timeless look that suits any kitchen decor.
        • BUILT-IN SIDE HANDLES FOR EASY USE – Thoughtfully designed side handles make it easy to move ingredients or serve dishes directly from counter to table. Each serving board with handles doubles as a serving tray or cheese platter, pairing beautifully with your everyday kitchen gadgets, making it ideal for family dinners, brunches, and entertaining guests.
        • GENTLE ON KNIVES, TOUGH ON WEAR - The smooth bamboo surface is naturally knife-friendly, helping preserve blade sharpness while resisting scratches and marks. A protective finish prevents water and odor absorption, keeping each bamboo cutting board clean, fresh, and ready for daily use.
        • DEEP JUICE GROOVE FOR MESS-FREE PREP - Each cutting board for kitchen features a deep juice groove along the edge to capture liquids from meats, fruits, or vegetables, preventing spills and keeping your countertops spotless. Ideal for clean, organized meal prep and easy transfer to your cookware.
        • DURABLE & MOISTURE-RESISTANT BAMBOO - Made from strong, pre-oiled carbonized bamboo, this eco-friendly cutting board set is built to withstand years of use. Resistant to cracking, warping, and water absorption, it maintains its shape and strength even after daily chopping, serving, and cleaning.
        • EASY TO CLEAN, EASY TO LOVE - Simply rinse, wipe, and it’s ready for the next meal. The sealed bamboo surface is naturally resistant to stains and odors. For best results, hand wash with mild soap and warm water - this wood cutting board set is made for hassle-free upkeep.
        • GIFT-READY QUALITY FOR ANY OCCASION - Beautifully packaged and built to impress, this Royal Craft Wood bamboo board set makes an ideal kitchen appliances and kitchen gift for weddings, housewarmings, birthdays, or holidays. A thoughtful blend of style, sustainability, and everyday practicality.
        • 💰𝐌𝐎𝐍𝐄𝐘-𝐁𝐀𝐂𝐊 𝐖𝐀𝐑𝐑𝐀𝐍𝐓𝐘: Our brand, ROYAL CRAFT WOOD is committed to providing our customers the best possible support and satisfaction.         Product description

        Previous page
        Next page
        Previous page
        Next page

        • What makes carbonized bamboo cutting boards a better choice?

          Carbonized bamboo is heat-treated for a denser, harder surface that helps resist moisture, odors, and buildup. It supports cleaner, healthier food prep and is pre-oiled to handle 1,000+ hand washes.

        • Does it have a deep juice groove?

          Yes. Each board features a deep, built-in groove that channels juices from meats, fruits, and veggies away from the surface, helping keep prep contained and countertops clean - no extra trays needed.

        • Is it reversible?

          Yes. Each board is double-sided - one side with a deep juice groove for prep, the other smooth for serving. It easily doubles as a charcuterie board, perfect for both indoor and outdoor use.

        • Is it made from sustainable bamboo?

          Yes. Made from solid carbonized natural bamboo. Carbonization deepens color, increases hardness, and helps reduce moisture and odor absorption for cleaner food prep.

              How to evaluate reviews for this product...
              Reviewed in the United States on April 10, 2021
              Color: NaturalSize: 4-Piece
              Verified Purchase
              Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
              Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

              If you are thinking about purchasing this product I will give you some helpful advice on how to evaluate previous reviews to determine if this is the right cutting board (set) for you. Sort them by rating high to low. Once you have done this you will be looking at a list of how people take care of their kitchen items from "very careful" to "it should just work without maintenance".

              If you own knives you probably understand that they aren't just always going to be sharp. Cutting on certain surfaces will dull them. Using a knife block can dull them. They require sharpening and care. Sure some will last longer and keep their edge better due to their quality, but you need to care about what you own and put in some effort at keeping your items in good shape so they will do what you purchased them for.

              The reason I say all of this is because I purchased these expecting all sorts of problems. I expected splinters and separation of the bamboo pieces. Know what I found? A decent quality cutting board that requires a certain level of care to keep in good shape. While I think it is possible that a few bad ones left the factory, the number of problems people are having with these lead me to believe that they aren't being oiled and/or they are being submerged and allowed to absorb water. I'm not going to say this is the finest cutting board on the market, but I do think that a lot of the hate is misplaced. I have now been using these for a couple of weeks and they have performed flawlessly. I really think that this is a solid 4 star set. Is it easy to clean? Well it is wood so no it isn't as easy to clean as glass. Is it sturdy? Again, it is made up of pieces of bamboo so it probably isn't as sturdy as a solid board would be. Craftsmanship? I don't think this was made by a craftsman who cares what he is shipping out the door. I haven't experienced splintering so far and it feels well made but it is a mass produced product so I don't think it earns 5 stars there either.

              Ultimately this is a good set that presents an incredible value if you are in the market for bamboo boards. I cook for my family at home and I plan on taking care of these so they will serve me well. It comes with care instructions and everyone who purchases these would be well served by reading them. I doubt they will win any awards or be used in any top kitchens around the world, but they are a good set and a great value.

            • THREE IDEAL SIZES FOR EVERY TASK - This bamboo cutting board set includes three essential cutting board sizes - 15x10”, 12x8”, 9x6” - covering all your kitchen needs. Use the small board for quick fruit prep, the medium for slicing vegetables, and the large for carving meats, rolling dough, or creating an elegant charcuterie board spread.
            • DESIGNED FOR FUNCTIONAL ELEGANCE – Crafted from 100% natural bamboo, these non toxic wooden cutting boards for kitchen combine modern design with practical performance. Perfectly complementing your kitchen appliances and favorite kitchen gadgets, their smooth, non-porous finish highlights the natural wood grain, blending durability with a timeless look that suits any kitchen decor.
            • BUILT-IN SIDE HANDLES FOR EASY USE – Thoughtfully designed side handles make it easy to move ingredients or serve dishes directly from counter to table. Each serving board with handles doubles as a serving tray or cheese platter, pairing beautifully with your everyday kitchen gadgets, making it ideal for family dinners, brunches, and entertaining guests.
            • GENTLE ON KNIVES, TOUGH ON WEAR - The smooth bamboo surface is naturally knife-friendly, helping preserve blade sharpness while resisting scratches and marks. A protective finish prevents water and odor absorption, keeping each bamboo cutting board clean, fresh, and ready for daily use.
            • DEEP JUICE GROOVE FOR MESS-FREE PREP - Each cutting board for kitchen features a deep juice groove along the edge to capture liquids from meats, fruits, or vegetables, preventing spills and keeping your countertops spotless. Ideal for clean, organized meal prep and easy transfer to your cookware.
